papers.title: Rapid Flood Inundation Forecast Using Fourier Neural Operator
papers.abstract: Flood inundation forecast provides critical information for emergency planning before and during flood events. Real time flood inundation forecast tools are still lacking. High-resolution hydrodynamic modeling has become more accessible in recent years, however, predicting flood extents at the street and building levels in real-time is still computationally demanding. Here we present a hybrid process-based and data-driven machine learning (ML) approach for flood extent and inundation depth prediction. We used the Fourier neural operator (FNO), a highly efficient ML method, for surrogate modeling. The FNO model is demonstrated over an urban area in Houston (Texas, U.S.) by training using simulated water depths (in 15-min intervals) from six historical storm events and then tested over two holdout events. Results show FNO outperforms the baseline U-Net model. It maintains high predictability at all lead times tested (up to 3 hrs) and performs well when applying to new sites, suggesting strong generalization skill.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法使用傅里叶神经算子进行代理建模，但应用于洪水预测而非生物力学植入物设计，且缺乏不确定性量化和约束处理。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant biomechanics; it is applied to flood inundation forecasting, not structural mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现实时洪水淹没预测，需要替代高计算成本的水动力模型。
summary_zh.method: 使用傅里叶神经算子（FNO）训练历史风暴事件模拟数据，预测洪水范围。
summary_zh.result: FNO优于U-Net，在3小时预测内保持高精度，且对新地点泛化良好。
summary_zh.validation: 基于六次历史风暴事件的模拟水深数据训练，并测试于两次留出事件。

summary_en.motivation: To enable real-time flood inundation forecasts, a surrogate model is needed to replace computationally expensive high-resolution hydrodynamic simulations.
summary_en.method: A Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) is trained on simulated water depths from six historical storm events to predict flood extents.
summary_en.result: FNO outperforms a U-Net baseline, maintaining high predictability up to 3 hours and generalizing to new sites.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated on holdout storm events using data generated from a process-based hydrodynamic model.

papers.title: Transport Equation based Physics Informed Neural Network to predict the Yield Strength of Architected Materials
papers.abstract: In this research, the application of the Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) model is explored to solve transport equation-based Partial Differential Equations (PDEs). The primary objective is to analyze the impact of different activation functions incorporated within the PINN model on its predictive performance, specifically assessing the Mean Squared Error (MSE) and Mean Absolute Error (MAE). The dataset used in the study consists of a varied set of input parameters related to strut diameter, unit cell size, and the corresponding yield stress values. Through this investigation the aim is to understand the effectiveness of the PINN model and the significance of choosing appropriate activation functions for solving complex PDEs in real-world applications. The outcomes suggest that the choice of activation function may have minimal influence on the model's predictive accuracy for this particular problem. The PINN model showcases exceptional generalization capabilities, indicating its capacity to avoid overfitting with the provided dataset. The research underscores the importance of striking a balance between performance and computational efficiency while selecting an activation function for specific real-world applications. These valuable findings contribute to advancing the understanding and potential adoption of PINN as an effective tool for solving challenging PDEs in diverse scientific and engineering domains.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文使用PINN进行代理建模，可迁移至生物力学领域，但缺乏不确定性量化和约束处理。
llm.why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling, and no application to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用PINN求解输运方程，预测点阵材料屈服强度。
summary_zh.method: 构建含不同激活函数的PINN模型，基于数据集训练。
summary_zh.result: 激活函数选择对精度影响小，PINN泛化能力强。
summary_zh.validation: 使用MSE和MAE在数据集上评估模型性能。

summary_en.motivation: To apply Physics-Informed Neural Networks to solve a transport PDE for predicting the yield strength of architected materials.
summary_en.method: A PINN model with various activation functions was trained on a dataset of strut diameter, unit cell size, and yield stress values.
summary_en.result: The activation function choice had minimal effect on predictive accuracy, and the PINN demonstrated strong generalization without overfitting.
summary_en.validation: Model performance was validated using mean squared error and mean absolute error on the same dataset; no independent experimental validation was performed.

papers.title: Extended tensor decomposition model reduction methods: training, prediction, and design under uncertainty
papers.abstract: This paper introduces an extended tensor decomposition (XTD) method for model reduction. The proposed method is based on a sparse non-separated enrichment to the conventional tensor decomposition, which is expected to improve the approximation accuracy and the reducibility (compressibility) in highly nonlinear and singular cases. The proposed XTD method can be a powerful tool for solving nonlinear space-time parametric problems. The method has been successfully applied to parametric elastic-plastic problems and real time additive manufacturing residual stress predictions with uncertainty quantification. Furthermore, a combined XTD-SCA (self-consistent clustering analysis) strategy has been presented for multi-scale material modeling, which enables real time multi-scale multi-parametric simulations. The efficiency of the method is demonstrated with comparison to finite element analysis. The proposed method enables a novel framework for fast manufacturing and material design with uncertainties.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法提出的张量分解模型降阶技术可用于生物力学代理模型构建，但未涉及植入物设计与骨骼界面力学。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not cover implant-specific contact mechanics, bone-implant interface, or patient-specific biomechanics validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升强非线性时空参数问题的模型降阶精度与可压缩性
summary_zh.method: 提出扩展张量分解方法，引入稀疏非分离富集项改进传统分解
summary_zh.result: 成功应用于弹塑性及增材制造残余应力预测，支持不确定性量化
summary_zh.validation: 与有限元对比验证计算效率与精度

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and compressibility of model reduction for highly nonlinear and singular parametric space-time problems.
summary_en.method: An extended tensor decomposition (XTD) method with sparse non-separated enrichment is proposed.
summary_en.result: The method accurately and efficiently predicts elastic-plastic and additive manufacturing residual stress with uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing predictions with full-order finite element simulations.
